DATR-VBEAM.description: Deflection at Rating - Vehicle Beam (DATR). Fields are driven by LTM_TYPE (0=Auto Calculation, 1=User Input) and POSITION (0=I, 1=J, 2=I & J), which select whether the strain/benefit factors or the manual adjustment factor apply.

POSITION.description: Position Type: 0=I, 1=J, 2=I & J. Range-validated (0-2) in the handler.

LTM_TYPE.description: Load Test Measurement Type: 0=Auto Calculation, 1=User Input. Range-validated (0-1) in the handler.

STRAIN_I.description: [LTM_TYPE=0 and POSITION=0 or 2] Strain at I-End. When applicable it must be >= 0.

STRAIN_J.description: [LTM_TYPE=0 and POSITION=1 or 2] Strain at J-End. When applicable it must be >= 0.

KB.description: [LTM_TYPE=0] Load Test Measurement Benefit Factor. When applicable it must be > 0.

K.description: [LTM_TYPE=1] Adjustment Factor. When applicable it must be > 0.
